title: The Origin and Growth of the Healing Art A Popular History of Medicine in All Ages and Countries

This work provides a comprehensive exploration of the history of medicine across various cultures and time periods, aiming to illuminate the evolution of medical practices from their primitive roots to more modern understandings. Berdoe emphasizes the significant roles that medicine and healing have played in shaping civilizations and societies. The opening portion of the book introduces the theme of medicine as a fundamental aspect of human civilization, beginning with its practices in primitive societies. The text elaborates on various primitive theories of disease, linking illness to spiritual and supernatural causes, such as animism, witchcraft, and demonic possession.
